question: Suppose the system of equations $x + y + z = 1$, $x + 2y + 3z = 4$, and $x + 4y + 9z = k$ has a unique solution. What is the value of $k$?

System is $ egin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & 1 \ 1 & 2 & 3 \ 1 & 4 & 9\end{bmatrix} egin{bmatrix}x \ y \ z\end{bmatrix} = egin{bmatrix}1 \ 4 \ k\end{bmatrix}$

Determinant:
$ egin{vmatrix}1 & 1 & 1\ 1 & 2 & 3\ 1 & 4 & 9\end{vmatrix}$

$= 1(18-12) -1(9-3) +1(4-2)$
$=1 imes 6 -1 imes 6 +1 imes 2 =6-6+2=2$

So $2z=k-10\implies z= rac{k-10}{2}$
